_about: Road tunnels are a SEPARATE FEASIBILITY TASK (docs/01-project-boundary.md#tunnels). Tunnel segments are inventoried and reported as 'blocked' until a supported underground approach is proven. No surface connection is ever generated in place of a tunnel.

feasibility_questions: Does the player vehicle stay supported on a scenery-object surface that lies BELOW the terrain mesh, or does the simulator force contact with the terrain surface above it?
Is there a supported way to open a hole in the terrain/photogrammetry for a portal (terraform / exclusion behaviour around portals)?
Is lighting/occlusion inside a closed model acceptable (no sky lighting leaking)?
